articles.title: Hundreds arrested in violent protests across France as buildings burned and looted | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 数百人在法国各地的暴力抗议活动中被捕，建筑物被烧毁和抢劫| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
There have been violent clashes between protesters and police in French cities, during the latest day of demonstrations against education standards and the cost of living.

At least 400 people were arrested during what the French government described as an "escalation in violence”, as more than 500,000 people took to the streets.

In Paris riot police used tear gas and water cannon on crowds. Buildings were set alight in the capital and other areas, including in Limoges where a large fire broke out in the town hall.

There was looting in several cities, with widespread vandalism against city halls and businesses. In Lyon the city’s tourist office was burned.  Police said "hostile individuals" prevented firefighters from tackling the blaze.

The interior ministry said the protests involved "targeted acts of violence" from "hooded individuals" in places, including parts of the capital and also Marseille, Rennes, Toulouse and Angers. Damage to buildings was reported across France, including in Grenoble, Avignon, Pau, Montpellier and Valence.

Hundreds of thousands of students have protested in recent weeks over staff shortages and dilapidated facilities in the country's lycées - secondary schools attended by 15 to 18-year-olds.  They were joined in the latest protests by trade union members and other protest groups. These included the so-called gilets jaunes 'yellow vest' movement, who demonstrated against cost-of-living hikes for over a year from 2018.

The protests come as Frances faces a period of deep political uncertainty.  President Emmanuel Macron will leave office next year and polls suggest April's presidential election could come down to a fight between the leader of the National Rally, Marine Le Pen, and Jean-Luc Mélenchon of the hard-left La France Insoumise party.

Jane Hill presents BBC News at Ten reporting by James Waterhouse and Katya Adler. 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
在最近一天抗议教育水平和生活成本的示威活动中，法国城市的抗议者和警察之间发生了暴力冲突。

在法国政府所称的“暴力升级”期间，至少有400人被捕，超过50万人走上街头。

在巴黎，防暴警察对人群使用催泪瓦斯和水炮。

首都和其他地区的建筑物被点燃，包括在市政厅发生大火的里摩日。

几个城市发生了抢劫事件，市政厅和企业遭到广泛破坏。

在里昂，该市的旅游办公室被烧毁。

警方表示， “敌对个人”阻止消防员处理大火。

内政部表示，抗议活动涉及来自首都部分地区以及马赛，雷恩，图卢兹和昂热等地的“蒙面人”的“有针对性的暴力行为”。

据报道，法国各地的建筑物遭到破坏，包括格勒诺布尔、阿维尼翁、波城、蒙彼利埃和瓦朗斯。

最近几周，数十万学生抗议该国中学（ 15至18岁的学生就读的中学）的工作人员短缺和设施破旧。

工会成员和其他抗议团体加入了最新的抗议活动。

其中包括所谓的黄背心“黄背心”运动，从2018年开始，他们抗议生活费用上涨一年多。

articles.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 意大利部长告诉BBC | BBC新闻，特朗普限制对乌克兰的支持是“完全错误的”
articles.summary:
Italy's defence minister has said it was a "complete mistake, a major mistake" for the US to limit access to satellite systems and intelligence used by Ukraine to defend itself against Russian attacks.

Guido Crosetto warned in a BBC interview that any such move by US President Donald Trump's administration "makes absolutely no sense" and risked prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to bring peace. Trump has denied asking for satellite access to be suspended.

Crosetto's comments continue Italy's sharpening criticism of the US.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#DonaldTrump #Italy #BBCNews

articles.title: Naomi Klein on the end of capitalism | BBC Radical
articles.titleZh: Naomi Klein谈资本主义的终结| BBC激进
articles.summary:
Naomi Klein has been writing critiques of capitalism and globalisation for more than 20 years. But now, for one of the most influential and outspoken figures on the political left, things are getting desperate. In her latest book 'End Times Fascism' she writes about how the global economic order is combining with other powerful forces to hasten the end of the world as we know it.

The author and social activist tells Gabriel Gatehouse about the religious fundamentalists, tech bros and white supremacists that keep her up at night, and her ideas about how to stop them - including dismantling capitalism, and why it hasn't happened yet.

#NaomiKlein #Radical #Fascim #Capitalism

articles.readingTextZh:
20多年来， Naomi Klein一直在撰写对资本主义和全球化的批评。

但现在，对于政治左翼中最具影响力和最直言不讳的人物之一来说，事情变得越来越绝望。

在她最新出版的《末日法西斯主义》一书中，她写道，全球经济秩序如何与其他强大力量相结合，加速我们所知道的世界末日。

这位作家和社会活动家向加布里埃尔·盖特豪斯（ Gabriel Gatehouse ）讲述了让她夜不能寐的宗教原教旨主义者、科技兄弟和白人至上主义者，以及她关于如何阻止他们的想法--包括拆除资本主义，以及为什么它还没有发生。

grammar.title: 听力训练建议
grammar.body: 第一遍不暂停，抓主旨；第二遍记录人物、地点、数字和关键动词；第三遍结合词汇解析复听。视频本身为媒体原声，学习正文为辅助训练材料。

grammar.title: 难度说明
grammar.body: A1–C1 等级根据标题长度和部分词汇线索估算，仅供学习参考，并非官方 CEFR 评定。

notice: All videos are from official publisher channels. Study text is taken from the publisher-provided video description, not fabricated transcript text; video descriptions may be shorter than the actual video. If an official channel feed is temporarily unavailable, the updater preserves the last known dataset.
